notes.title: Ultima Chess VR - Release Date Changed!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Ultima Chess VR is a unique experience. It is not only a chess project, but also a part of our Ultima Realm universe. Within it, a piece of its story will be told, which will continue in the upcoming games.

Since this is an ambitious franchise, we need a bit more time to polish and improve the experience, as well as refine the mechanics, content, and more.

Therefore, our team has decided to postpone the release date from September 2025 to 2026.

We eagerly look forward to the moment when you can dive into the chess competitions and the world of Ultima Realm, and discover its story.

Thank you for your support.

Sincerely,
The Ultima Realm Team.
